$comment: Round 2 of the 7050TX-64 unblock probes (run 8, 2026-11-15). Round 1 (run 7) produced three
INCONCLUSIVE answers that were MY OWN invented spellings, not the box's verdicts — the DR-135
lesson, repeated live: (a) I staged bare `vrf UNBLOCK-PROBE`, but this client composes
`vrf instance X` (>= 4.23) / `vrf definition X` (vrfs.ts, W2d #41); (b) I staged `bgp router-id`,
but bgp.ts:535 composes plain `router-id <value>` inside the process; (c) I staged
`spanning-tree mode mst`, but the ported verb admits ONLY mstp|none (stp.ts set_mode / DR-096).
Round 2 therefore stages ONLY command texts read out of the ported resources, one question per
batch, exactly like the main draft. Every batch is allowCommit:false: stage -> record the diff ->
ABORT. Nothing reaches running-config; default forwarding is untouched (the 2026-11-15
authorization). Refusals are recorded as answers and the loop continues (DR-134).
Run-7 settled facts this spec builds on: `interface Vxlan1` STAGES (the stanza + its auto
`vxlan udp-port 4789` reached the diff); `router bgp 65199` opener STAGES; MST region config
stages; `router ospf 1` + bare `router-id` + `passive-interface default` stage FULLY (the diff
even shows the auto `max-lsa 12000`); `show bgp summary|neighbors` answer '% Not supported' on
this SKU while the OSPF/route-map reads parse; license features are EMPTY (open item 2).
NO batch uses {{SCRATCH}}; run with EAPI_SCRATCH_INTERFACE unset.
RUN (from the repo root, after the §2 env chain in docs/HARDWARE-CAPTURE.md):
export EAPI_HW_SESSION_PROBE=1
export EAPI_HW_PROBE_SPEC=$PWD/arista-api-client/docs/hw-capture-unblock2.draft.json
npm -w arista-api-client run test:live -- src/hw-session-probe.live.test.ts
